title: Uneraseable - THE BUS FROM VEGAS & THE LIBRARY OF THE FATES

critiques.speaker: Eusacles
critiques.quote: "Two hundred kilometers..." Eusacles repeated, his voice climbing in disbelief. "That is so far from Vegas! Not even a little bit close! All I wanted to do was play roulette!"
critiques.comment: I'm pretty sure this is Pierre

critiques.speaker: Narrator
critiques.quote: "I'm four feet below you, mate!" a sharp, raspy Cockney voice piped up from the grass. "Somebody's got to pick me up if you're trying to talk to me!"

critiques.speaker: Narrator
critiques.quote: With a sharp click, the doll sprang back to life, immediately swinging its tiny needle wildly at the tall stalks of crabgrass like a miniature lawnmower.
critiques.comment: I don't know what's happening here but it makes no sense

critiques.speaker: Pierre
critiques.quote: Pierre knelt and gently offered his open hand to the swinging driftwood doll. "Would you like a ride?"
critiques.comment: The jumping back and forth without any transition text is hard to follow
